build: TAP of the original Elite cassette (1,530,784 bytes): a 512-byte Novaload boot program in the KERNAL's format, then 26 Novaload files: the loader's second stage, the loading picture, the program in four files, and five question blocks of four files each, which the game loads during play

comments.text: Sound effects, once a frame: called by the raster handler at $0696 when effects_loaded is set (in place of music_play). Saves the zero-page pointer $FB/$FC, then for each voice 2..0 with a script running (fx_pos not 0) counts fx_count down, reads the next step at 0 (fx_step), and adds fx_delta to fx_freq and writes the frequency to the SID every frame. Restores $FB/$FC.
One voice: X = voice 0-2. A voice whose fx_pos is 0 is silent and skipped.

Glide: fx_freq += fx_delta (16 bits, the carry of the low byte into the high), written to the voice's frequency registers ($D400/$D401 + the voice's SID offset). Every effect in the file has a delta of 0, so this only rewrites the same note.
fx_frame: the end of one voice (dex, next voice). Labelled because the music driver jumps to $4F31 (its music_write_voice in the menu part), which does not run once effects are loaded.
Puts back the caller's $FB/$FC: the effects code borrows them as its script pointer.

Reads the next step of voice X's script (pointer from fx_lo/fx_hi by fx_effect,x; offset fx_pos,x). A step is a control byte (waveform and gate, to $D404+offset), then the frequency high and low bytes (to fx_freq); fx_count is reloaded from the script's first byte (bits 0-6). Commands before a step: $FE lo hi pulse width, $FD lo hi set the glide delta, $FC clear the delta, $FF end of script. Saves the new offset in fx_pos,x.
The step loop: Y = offset into the script, X = the voice's SID offset (0, 7 or 14).
A plain step: control register now; the frequency is stored for fx_frame to write.

$FF, end of a script: with the repeat bit (fx_repeat) set the script starts again at its first step (fx_loop); else fx_pos = 0 and the voice's control register is cleared (gate off, no waveform). No effect in the file sets the repeat bit.

fx_end, repeating script: Y = fx_loop,x, the first step again, and back to the step loop. Labelled because the music driver jumps to $4F9F (its music_command), which does not run once effects are loaded.
$FC: clear the glide delta. It indexes fx_delta with the SID offset in X, not the voice number, so on voices 2 and 3 it would hit the wrong bytes; no script in the file uses $FC or $FD.
$FD lo hi: set the glide delta (same indexing slip as $FC).

Starts sound effect X (0-10) on SID voice Y (0-2), replacing whatever that voice was playing. Callers set X/Y with literal loads (9 calls, byte search of the quiz snapshot): $09FF 6/0 answer chosen, $0D7F 5/0 Jukebox number chosen, $2F68 3/1 clock tick, $2FB8 8/1 time up, $30E0 4/1 correct answer, $3131+$3138 and $3171+$3178 1/1 and 2/2 together for a wrong answer. Effects 0, 7, 9 and 10 have no caller. It shares the voice tables ($50B5-$50E1) and the filter registers with fx_frame, which the interrupt runs: an interrupt that comes in the middle of fx_start (8 of 132 calls in a game on the kit's machine, work/play/g4/race.js) changes what the two leave in $D416/$D418.
Script pointer = fx_lo/fx_hi [X] into $FB/$FC; the voice's SID offset, its filter bit and mask, and the voice number are kept in fx_tmp_*.
Script header: byte 0 = frames a step lasts (bits 0-6) and the repeat flag (bit 7); bytes 1-2 the glide delta; 3 attack/decay; 4 sustain/release; 5-6 pulse width.

Byte 7, filter: low nibble 0 = take this voice out of the filter; 2 = leave the filter as it is; anything else = high nibble is the filter mode written to $D418 (volume always 15), the next byte the cutoff's high byte ($D416), and the voice goes through the filter.
Then the first step: control byte, frequency high, frequency low. The control byte's offset becomes fx_loop, the restart point of a repeating script.

Silences the effects: clears every voice's fx_pos and fx_count, zeroes all 25 SID registers $D400-$D418, sets fx_filter to $F0 (resonance 15, no voice filtered) and the volume to 15 ($D418 = $0F). Called once, by irq_setup at $2B58, when effects_loaded is set (byte search: the only JSR to $5095).
The filter-routing bit of voices 0-2 (1, 2, 4), ORed into fx_filter by fx_start when a script filters its voice.
The same bits inverted ($FE, $FD, $FB), ANDed into fx_filter to take a voice out of the filter.
The effect number playing on voices 0-2, written by fx_start, read by fx_step to find the script.
Offset of the next step in each voice's script; 0 = the voice is idle. Written by fx_start, fx_step and fx_end; cleared by fx_init.
